question.text: Let <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>O</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mn>0,0</mn></mfenced><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mn>3,0</mn></mfenced><mo>,</mo><mo> </mo><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>0</mn><mo>,</mo><mo>-</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mi>C</mi><mo>=</mo><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>3,2</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>, then the minimum value of <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mi>z</mi></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mi>z</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn></mrow></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mi>z</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>i</mi></mrow></mfenced><mo>+</mo><mfenced close="|" open="|" separators="|"><mrow><mi>z</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>3</mn><mo>-</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>i</mi></mrow></mfenced></math> occurs at the (where, <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mi>z</mi></math> is a complex number)

solution.text:
The minimum value of z+z-3 occurs at points on the line segment joining O & A
Similarly, the minimum value of z+i+z-3-2i
occurs at points on the line segment joining B & C.
⇒ The minimum value of z+z-3+z+i+z-3-2i
occurs at point of intersection of OA & BC.
